Our Story

A Mountain Escape
Like No Other

Nestled in the breathtaking hills of Badulla, Sri Lanka, Kites Mountain Hotel is a luxury retreat that seamlessly blends natural beauty with refined comfort. From our open-air mountain bar to our lush pool terrace, every corner is designed to take your breath away.

Whether you're visiting for a romantic getaway, a family celebration, or a corporate retreat, we offer personalised experiences that create lasting memories.
